result.requirement: The system shall automatically calculate and distribute transaction revenue to the Platform Operator, Store Partner, and Payment Provider immediately upon delivery confirmation.
result.business_need: The business needs to ensure accurate, transparent, and timely financial settlement for all parties involved in a transaction to maintain trust and operational efficiency.
functional_behaviour: The system shall validate the Delivery Proof associated with the Order Request before initiating any financial distribution.
The system shall retrieve the commission rates and payout terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
The system shall calculate the net settlement amount for each party based on the Financial Transaction Record.
The system shall generate a Financial Transaction Record detailing the split of revenue between the Platform Operator, Store Partner, and Payment Provider.
The system shall update the status of the Order Request to 'Settled' once the distribution logic is executed.
The system shall flag the transaction for manual review if the calculated amounts deviate from expected thresholds based on historical data.
related_information_requirements: Complete record of monetary exchange including item costs, fees, taxes, and commissions
Verifiable evidence of physical goods handover to the customer
Contractual details regarding commission rates and payout schedules
Verified details of the ordering individual and delivery address
Qualitative ratings regarding product quality and delivery speed
business_rules: Financial distribution shall only occur after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
Transactions involving high-risk indicators must be paused for manual verification before settlement.
Settlement calculations must strictly adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement.
A Financial Transaction Record must be generated for every completed delivery regardless of outcome.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the settlement event
acceptance_criteria.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties

acceptance_criteria.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
acceptance_criteria.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
acceptance_criteria.then: The system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review
